run_gtest_help_test_with_flag: run the gtest_help_test_ binary with a given command-line flag and return exit code and output
test_help_flag_variants: test that gtest prints help output when passed --help, -h, -?, or /? flags
test_help_on_unknown_flag: test that gtest prints help output when an unrecognized gtest flag is passed
test_help_on_incorrect_flag_style: test that gtest prints help output when flags use incorrect prefix style like single dash or slash
test_runs_without_help_flag: test that gtest runs tests normally and does not print help when no help flag is provided
